target: forge.sh kind — github.com / www.github.com in https, scp and ssh forms, case-insensitive
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://github.com/o/r.git
k() { fx_setremote "$2"; fx_run kind; echo "$1=$FX_OUT"; }
k https https://github.com/o/r.git
k www https://www.github.com/o/r
k scp git@github.com:o/r.git
k ssh ssh://git@github.com/o/r.git
k upper https://GitHub.COM/o/r.git
k wwwscp git@www.github.com:o/r.git
fx_done
